EICMA 2026 • Honda Africa Twin Gets Biggest Refresh in a Decade, They Now Call It CRF1150L
NASCAR Driver Joey Logano Drives His Super Truck for the First Time: It's a Raptor R With a Twist
11 photos
Photo: Hennessey Performance | YouTube
NASCAR driver Joey Logano has just taken delivery of his VelociRaptoR. It is, in fact, a Ford F-150 Raptor R with a twist. It is a 1,000-horsepower twist signed by Hennessey Performance and transformed into the ultimate high-performance off-road truck.
NASCAR drivers don't drive Mitsubishi Mirages or Toyota Priuses. It is in their bllood to go for the most powerful and fastest vehicles out there. When the standard car market is not enough, they raise the stakes. This is what three-time NASCAR Cup Series champion Joey Logano did.
Even if he is used to taming hundreds of horsepower at the track, he was so pumped up on delivery day that he got up at 4 A.M. Company founder John Hennessey personally traveled to North Carolina to hand over the new owner of the super truck at his own dealership, Huntersville Ford, in November 2026.
The dealership is located near his home and his production studio in the Charlotte metro area and specializes in lifted trucks, supercharged builds, and performance models through an on-site custom accessory shop and its "Logano Speed Works" builds. Now, his truck will tower over all those sitting in the parking lot of his dealership, which opened in May 2026.
Photo: Hennessey Performance | YouTube The monstrous VelociRaptoR is basically a Ford F-150 Raptor R with a twist. It’s been touched by Hennessey Performance’s magic wand, which transformed it into the most powerful pickup truck with a combustion engine out there.
The F-150 Raptor R rolls off the production line of Ford’s Dearborn Truck Plant in Michigan with a 5.2-liter supercharged V8 under the hood. The V8, derived from the GT500’s Predator, pumps out 720 horsepower (730 metric horsepower) and 640 pound-feet (868 Newton meters) of torque.
That is what makes it flash from zero to hero (0 to 60 mph or 0 to 97 kph) in 3.6 seconds, run the quarter mile in 12.0 seconds with a trap speed of 112 mph (180 kph), and max out at a top speed of 114 mph (183 kph), electronically limited due to the speed rating of its massive 37-inch off-road tires.
However, those numbers are no longer valid because Hennessey Performance upgraded the factory V8 to produce a massive 1,000 horsepower and 1,000 pound-feet of torque (with the help of a new 3.8-liter supercharger mounted on top of the engine. However, from the passenger seat, John Hennessey tells him the actual number is 1,200 horsepower (1,217 metric horsepower).
Photo: Hennessey Performance | YouTube The 6,500-pound (2,948-kilogram) monster got upgraded wheels and tires, while six-piston Brembo brakes handle the extra oomph, because at 1,000 horsepower (1,014 metric horsepower) and 1,000 pound-feet (1,356 Newton meters) of torque, you need all the grip and brake power that you can get.
Now, the Ford F-150 Raptor R-based truck has shaved off half a second of the 0-to-60 time, being clocked at 3.1 seconds, and takes 11.4 seconds to run the quarter mile, but the speed limit hasn't changed due to the limitation of those off-road tires.
Joey Logano's VelociRaptoR wears a custom front bumper, which integrates LED off-road lights. The truck also got a custom cabin, trimmed in leather and Alcantara with contrasting orange accents all throughout. The build also got an upgraded serial plaque under the hood and a hidden Easter egg, featuring its owner’s personal racing logo.
Now, the world-class race car driver Joey Logano, with no fewer than 39 wins under his belt, takes his brand-new truck for a spin to see what he can do. In his hands, it pulls like a freight train, but the traction control is a little overwhelmed by his quick reactions.
Photo: Hennessey Performance | YouTube Joye’s brand-new VelociRaptoR will join an exclusive collection of cars. In his garage, he has the most powerful production Ford Mustang ever built, the GTD with its 815 horsepower (826 metric horsepower), a 2017 Ford GT Heritage Edition, a 1971 Ford Mustang Mach, a 1980 Ford Mustang Fox Body, and a Ford Model A Rat Rod and a Model T among his Blue Oval-badged cars, because the man has raced with Ford his whole life.
His garage also hosts a DeLorean DMC-12 , a 1972 Oldsmobile Cutlass, and a 1993 Ferrari 512 TR. His retired NASCAR Cup Series trophy cars are also there, but because they are not street legal, these are the only ones that he doesn’t drive and only keeps as display pieces.
In the meantime, Joey Logano drove the Number 22 Team Penske Ford Mustang Dark Horse in the 2026 NASCAR Cup Series season. Ford also unveiled the updated Mustang Dark Horse S body style that he will race next season.
While the street-legal Ford Mustang Dark Horse SC makes 795. Horsepower (806 metric horsepower), Joey Logano’s NASCAR Cup Series race version is regulated to produce 670 or 750 horsepower, depending on the track. That is far under what his brand-new VelociRaptoR can do.
